description: Implementation of virtual network interface layer for Zephyr OS, including functions for attaching/detaching interfaces, packet handling, and interface management.

methods.name: virtual_recv
methods.description: Handles received packets; currently always continues processing.

methods.name: virtual_send
methods.description: Sends a packet through the virtual interface API.

methods.name: virtual_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the virtual interface, bringing underlying interfaces up or down as needed.

methods.name: virtual_flags
methods.description: Returns the flags for the virtual interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_interface_attach
methods.description: Attaches or detaches a virtual interface to/from another interface, setting link address.

methods.name: net_virtual_disable
methods.description: Disables all virtual interfaces attached to a given interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_enable
methods.description: Enables all virtual interfaces attached to a given interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_get_iface
methods.description: Retrieves the underlying interface associated with a virtual interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_get_name
methods.description: Gets the name of a virtual interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_set_name
methods.description: Sets the name of a virtual interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_set_flags
methods.description: Sets flags for a virtual interface and returns previous flags.

methods.name: net_virtual_input
methods.description: Processes incoming packets for virtual interfaces, determining IP family and dispatching to appropriate handlers.
